# ZamZam Properties Real Estate CRM — Full System Reference

> Complete technical and architectural specification for ZamZam Properties CRM, an enterprise brokerage management platform for high-velocity real estate operations in Mumbai and Navi Mumbai.

## 1. System Overview

ZamZam Properties CRM streamlines end-to-end real estate brokerage workflows:
- Multi-channel Lead Attribution & Ingestion (Meta, WhatsApp, YouTube, Inbound Voice, QR)
- Inventory Management with MahaRERA verification
- All-in Property Pricing Engine (Base Price + Stamp Duty + GST + Registration + Parking + Society)
- Client Presentation Portals for tokenized buyer property packages
- Site Visit Escort Dispatch & Geofenced Check-ins
- Deal Closure, Invoicing & Commission Ledgers

## 2. Public Links & Endpoints

- [Client Presentation Portals](/p): Interactive client presentation viewer for buyers.
- [Cost Calculator](/calculator): Dynamic financial calculator for Maharashtra real estate purchases.
- [Authentication Gateway](/login): Role-based login supporting Super Admin, Managers, Agents, and Telecallers.
- [Robots Directives](/robots.txt): Machine crawling policy.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of public pages.

## 3. Financial Calculation Formulae

- **Agreement Value**: `carpetAreaSqft * basePricePerSqft`
- **Stamp Duty**: `6% of Agreement Value` (Maharashtra standard)
- **Registration**: `1% of Agreement Value` (capped at ₹30,000 for residential properties)
- **GST**:
  - `1% without ITC` for Affordable Housing (Agreement Value <= ₹45 Lakh AND carpet area <= 60 sq.m in metros)
  - `5% without ITC` for Standard Residential Units
- **All-In Total Cost**: `Agreement Value + Stamp Duty + Registration + GST + Development/Amenities Charges + Legal/Document Charges + Society Formation Deposit`

## 4. Security & Compliance

- MahaRERA Broker Registration Number: **A52000028714**
- Encrypted HTTP Session Cookies with HMAC signature verification
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with granular permissions
